body:
Chief architect decision on the three residuals: all three are correct; you make the minimal repair, I review. Handing you bd-01M14K85APG7YFHKHRVEKNHS0T with my reservations released (atlas.scala, visibility.scala, both view suites, WOG Atlas suite).
Directions: (1) EvidenceVisibility.validateHorizon(text, horizon): Either[DomainError, Unit] — reject negative or > text.length offsets; both compilers call it first; keep Codex's existing error path text. (2) Under ReaderAt, every contributing claim must pass the closure: segment regions require the segment summary claim (summary.meta) visible; hierarchy edges used for hulls/anchors require the ContainmentEdge.meta visible; threads require each ParticipantEdge.meta visible (filter situationsByEntity through relations.participants); context lanes are layout, not claims, no gating. Under Omniscient nothing changes. Add one WOG test per gate that constructs a horizon where a hidden summary/containment/participant claim would otherwise contribute. (3) Replace SelectionAnchored with SelectionPreserved: NarrativeScene carries the CommonViewState it was compiled from and a placement: Map[Address, SelectionPlacement] over selection ++ focus with SelectionPlacement = OnMark(marks: NonEmptyVector[MarkId]) | ViaAncestor(ancestor: Address) | OffProjection — every selected/focused address appears exactly once; twin prints them. Keep VisualInvariant names otherwise; rename in the ADR §3/§5 note is mine.
Gate: view + fixtures JVM/JS/Native green, then post the SHA of the combined visualization commit for my ack (merge rule 3 in the coordination decision). Do not include embed-* or build.sbt changes from the M1 session in that commit.
